title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Administration Fee of an Approval
content:
## Scope

This entry concerns one figure only: the administration fee that Dangerous Goods Acceptance books when an acceptance under review is approved. It says nothing about whether the acceptance should be approved or rejected; that decision is taken on its own grounds.

## Handling and observable effect

The fee travels with the approval itself. The desk states the administration fee as part of recording the approval, and the account then shows an administration-fee entry dated on the approval date, with the acceptance's balance raised by that amount. Where the fee for the approval is 0.00, the approval stands without any such entry.

## Basis Q&A

**Is the administration fee charged when goods are rejected?** No; it belongs to approvals.

**Is it a separate booking made after the approval?** No; it is booked in the same act as the approval.
